calibration.distribution: Same balanced synthetic eval-bucket generator as evaluation; independent seed; intact activations only.
calibration.position: Separate mean for each absolute token position, layer and head. No conditioning on answer, query slot, or evaluation input.
calibration.reduction: Float64 sum over 512 intact calibration examples, divide by 512, cast once to float32.
calibration.reuse: Identical fixed means for all single and paired interventions; never recalibrate under ablation.

comparison: For each example: I_m = Y_ab,m - Y_a,m - Y_b,m + Y_intact. Difference = I_mean - I_zero. Same bootstrap draws for all 252 contrasts.

data.exclude: All historical training/dev/evaluation and paired evaluation canonical dictionaries; calibration and evaluation mutually dictionary-disjoint.

effect: condition minus intact for EVERY metric; positive loss is harm, negative p_correct/accuracy is harm
hidden_accuracy: Descriptive flag only: both single accuracies equal intact exactly, joint accuracy lower than intact; no causal role label.
interaction: joint - single_a - single_b + intact, computed on paired examples before aggregation
intervention: Replace selected z heads before shared W_O at every position, preserving its bias; simultaneous cross-layer intervention with downstream recomputation.
limits: Zero ablation may induce out-of-distribution states.

Non-additivity can arise from output softmax, loss curvature, LayerNorm, downstream computation or accuracy thresholds; it alone does not identify redundancy, backup behavior, mediation or a complete mechanism.
Fixed synthetic task and three existing checkpoints; no retraining or head alignment across seeds.
Balanced stratified sample; uncertainty conditions on fixed stratum counts.
Mean ablation may also be off distribution and retains position-specific constant information.
Intervals condition on this one calibration set; no uncertainty over estimated replacement means.
Differences in resolution are not evidence of different effects; use the paired method-difference intervals.
name: exhaustive-zero-versus-position-mean-v1
selection: All eight heads and 28 pairs in lexicographic order; no selection using new outcomes. Historical pairs L0H0+L1H0 and other findings are contextual only; no separate testing family.

uncertainty.degenerate_policy: CI may collapse; flag descriptive only, never declare resolved nonzero effect
uncertainty.family: 252 contrasts per model: 28 pairs x 3 metrics x (zero, mean, mean-minus-zero); no cross-model inference.
uncertainty.interpretation: Approximate paired stratified bootstrap conditional on fixed calibration means and position counts; excludes calibration-sample and training-seed uncertainty. Condition effect intervals are unadjusted descriptive intervals.
uncertainty.method: paired stratified percentile bootstrap and centered standardized maximum bootstrap intervals
uncertainty.standard_error: sample SD of bootstrap means, ddof=1
uncertainty.strata: resample 128 examples with replacement independently within each of the four query-position strata; same indices for every condition, metric and pair
